test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_int64_datetime_statistics.parquet', Parquet) SELECT toInt64(1700000000 + (number % 100000) + 100000 * ((intDiv(number, 100000) * 37 + 11) % 200)) AS t, toString(number) AS s FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 100000, max_block_size = 100000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT t, s FROM file('test_parquet_int64_datetime_statistics.parquet', Parquet, 't DateTime, s String') ORDER BY t LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
SELECT t, s FROM file('test_parquet_int64_datetime_statistics.parquet', Parquet, 't DateTime, s String') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null

SELECT count(), max(s) FROM file('test_parquet_int64_datetime_statistics.parquet', Parquet, 't DateTime, s String') WHERE t BETWEEN toDateTime(1705000000) AND toDateTime(1705050000) SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
